_source: Machine-parsed from Concord-Padgett Regional Airport's Airlines, Parking and Directions pages (concordairportnc.com/Airline-Information/Airlines, /Parking, /Directions), Nov 24 2026. Routes themselves come from etl/build_flights.py (bradspry/kannapolis-travel fetch_routes.py --flights-only). Airline colors match kannapolis-travel's generate_route_map.py.

airport.name: Concord-Padgett Regional Airport
airport.terminal_note: Some GPS and navigation apps default to the wrong terminal address: navigate to this address, not just to the airport.

parking.free: Under one hour is free (greeters, drop-offs, deliveries).
parking.where: Two-level parking deck in front of the terminal; the lower level is covered. Both levels are short- or long-term.
parking.pay: Card only at the exit kiosks; pay cash at the kiosk inside the terminal.
parking.overflow: When the deck fills on busy travel days and some holidays, an overflow lot on Aviation Blvd. (about a mile away) runs a shuttle to the terminal: allow at least 30 more minutes.

charter.text: Sun Country flies public charters from Concord for Caesars Rewards Air, packaged trips to Caesars Entertainment resorts and casinos.

city_names._source: The airport's Airlines page names these by area; OurAirports gives the municipality.
